cases.user_text: If my mother's hospital bills use up the whole sum insured in March, does the cover get restored for the rest of the year, or are we left with nothing until renewal?
My family floater is 10 lakh and my husband already claimed 7 lakh this year. If my son gets admitted next month, will we only have 3 lakh left, or does the policy bring the amount back up somehow?

What happens once the money in my health policy runs out partway through the year? Is there any chance I get the full cover amount again before my renewal date, and does it work if it's the same illness again?
Can someone explain in simple words how this restoration benefit works and whether it kicks in after I use only part of my sum insured or only after I use all of it?
